fields.title: 📖 When money grows large in the heart, the person becomes small
fields.body:
🖋️ **al-Ḥasan al-Baṣrī** said:

> ***“No one honors the dirham except that Allah humiliates him.”***

The attribution comes through **Hishām b. Ḥassān**, who expressly said that he heard al-Ḥasan swear by Allah.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Money is not the problem – **its place in the heart** is. In the hand it can be of benefit; in the heart it becomes humiliation. Whoever seeks his dignity with Allah lets the dunyā serve – not rule.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym al-Aṣbahānī, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ, Bd. 2, S. 152; über Hishām b. Ḥassān.
